name: Outlaw Tools v0.6.1
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.6.1

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.6.1

## Update Delivery

- Check a public static release manifest before GitHub's API, avoiding API rate limits. Keep the API as a fallback.
- Preserve update-check and download errors when displaying them on the desktop, instead of losing deferred error callbacks.
- Publish shared release metadata automatically after the public packages and checksums are available, for use by the app and website.
- Existing v0.5.12 or v0.6.0 installations affected by the old updater need one manual installation of this version from the latest Windows download.

## Known Limitations

- The v0.6.0 refinery and local-transfer limitations remain: review OCR values, and large-profile operations may cause intermittent UI pauses. Automatic cross-PC sync is not included.

## Downloads

- Windows: `OutlawTools-Setup-0.6.1.exe` and SHA-256 checksum.
- Linux: `OutlawTools-linux-x86_64-0.6.1.tar.gz` and SHA-256 checksum.
